title: Hollowmere
description: A mysterious town hiding secrets beneath its quiet surface. Follow the conversations, investigate strange digital records, and uncover the truth behind Hollowmere. But be careful. Some secrets were never meant to be found.
how_to_play:
1. Enter Hollowmere and explore the conversations.
2. Follow clues and investigate digital records.
3. Solve puzzles and connect the hidden details.
4. Discover the secrets buried beneath the town.
